Players Committee card image of [[Ancient Watering Hole (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Maz and your Rep are immune to attrition. While you have alien characters of five different species on table: your Force drains are +1, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if Maz or your Rep in battle), and your aliens are forfeit +1. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/ancientwateringhole.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/ancientwateringhole.png] as of commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered” (19 August 2024).
